Some Questions

*Where are the most expensive aribnbs in nyc?

Which neighborhood has the highest concentration? Which one is the cheapest? Which airbnb hosts are the most/best reviewed? Has the number increased or decreased over time? Do descriptions correlate wtih price What about text reviews?

His work:

nyc_airbnb =
  nyc_airbnb |> 
  mutate(stars = review_scores_location / 2)
nyc_airbnb |> 
  filter(neighbourhood_group == "Manhattan") |> 
  count(room_type, neighbourhood_group) |> 
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = room_type,
    values_from = n
  )
## # A tibble: 1 × 4
##   neighbourhood_group `Entire home/apt` `Private room` `Shared room`
##   <chr>                           <int>          <int>         <int>
## 1 Manhattan                       10814           7812           586

Price

nyc_airbnb |> 
  group_by(neighbourhood_group) |> 
  mutate(price_rank = min_rank(desc(price))) |> 
  filter(price_rank < 10) |>  view()
nyc_airbnb |> 
  filter(price < 1000) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = price)) +
  geom_histogram() +
  facet_grid(room_type ~ neighbourhood_group)
## `stat_bin()` using `bins = 30`. Pick better value `binwidth`.

prices on average

nyc_airbnb |> 
  group_by(room_type, neighbourhood_group) |> 
  summarize(
    mean_price = mean(price)
  ) |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = room_type,
    values_from = mean_price
  )
## `summarise()` has regrouped the output.
## ℹ Summaries were computed grouped by room_type and neighbourhood_group.
## ℹ Output is grouped by room_type.
## ℹ Use `summarise(.groups = "drop_last")` to silence this message.
## ℹ Use `summarise(.by = c(room_type, neighbourhood_group))` for per-operation
##   grouping (`?dplyr::dplyr_by`) instead.

Some host stuff

nyc_airbnb |> 
  filter(calculated_host_listings_count > 10) |> view()

Can we look at prices for neighbourhoods in Manhattan?

nyc_airbnb |> 
  filter(neighbourhood_group == "Manhattan") |> 
  filter(price < 500) |> 
  filter(room_type != "Shared room") |> 
  mutate(neighbourhood = fct_reorder(neighbourhood, price)) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = neighbourhood, y = price)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  facet_grid(. ~ room_type) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))

Visualize price some more (create graph of Manhattan)

nyc_airbnb |> 
  filter(neighbourhood_group == "Manhattan") |> 
  filter(room_type == "Entire home/apt") |> 
  filter(price < 500) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = lat, y = long, color = price)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5)

Make a leaflet map

nyc_airbnb |> 
  filter(neighbourhood_group == "Manhattan") |> 
  filter(room_type == "Entire home/apt") |> 
  filter(price < 500) |> 
  sample_n(50) |> 
  leaflet() |> 
  addTiles() |> 
  addMarkers(~lat, ~long)
pal = colorNumeric(
  palette = "viridis",
  domain = 1:500
)

nyc_airbnb |> 
  filter(neighbourhood_group == "Manhattan") |> 
  filter(room_type == "Entire home/apt") |> 
  filter(price < 500) |> 
 # sample_n(50) |> 
  leaflet() |> 
  addTiles() |> 
  addCircleMarkers(
    ~lat, ~long, color = ~pal(price), radius = .5)
